BiblicalUsage: Elisha tells the kings to smite every fenced city and every choice city of Moab. The word is the select city, the well-fortified one, and the command is to leave Moab no strong place standing.
TheologicalSignificance: I take Elisha's command as the measure of the judgment: every fenced city and every choice city, because Moab's strength was in its walls, and God would have none of it left.
